Evolution of Gaming: From Play for fun to Play to Earn

Play for Fun Model

From the 1970s to the early 2000s, the play-for model began where players didn’t have any opportunity to monetize games, and the only thing they could do was purchase games and subscriptions for fun. In the P2F model, a gamer had to purchase a gaming console or game disc but no source of income. Some popular games in the play-for-fun model include FIFA, Pacman, and Super Mario.

Free to Play Model

The evolution of smartphones in the 2010s and PCs played a huge role in giving a rapid boom to the free-to-play model. In the F2P game model, a user can download various games from the Google play store, or they can play various games online. Most game publishers earned the majority of income from in-game purchases and display ads. Some popular games include Roblox, Ragnarok, and League of Legends. The only way for gamers to earn in the F2P model is through video streaming.

Play to Earn Model

The P2E model has brought a massive revolution in the gaming world where gamers get to enjoy both entertainment & rewards. In the play-to-earn game, model players get a chance to monetize their efforts through crypto tokens and NFTs. Gamers can now generate value from their in-game assets even outside the game, whether in the form of NFT or cryptocurrency. One of the popular P2E games, Axie Infinity, has attracted 2.5 million gamers all across the globe.

Future of the Gaming World

Gaming is an integral part of the entertainment industry. A key takeaway for the gaming world is that a plethora of new features has been incorporated into the gaming world. The new P2E gaming model is helping players realize how they can make value from their gaming efforts. As technology advances, it will not be something new when someone tells us that their full-time occupation is playing P2E games.
